Title: Check close goal modal and close reason options

Step Action: Sign in as a care team member and navigate to PGI & Notes > Goals > Open.
Step Expected: The Open Goals list is displayed.

Step Action: Click the close goal icon on an open goal.
Step Expected: The Close Goal modal opens for the selected goal.

Step Action: Open the Close Reason dropdown and review its options.
Step Expected: The dropdown lists exactly: Deceased, Met/Resolved, No longer applies, and Patient did not want to complete.

Step Action: Attempt to close the goal without selecting a Close Reason.
Step Expected: The goal is not closed and the required Close Reason is indicated.

Step Action: Select a Close Reason, enter a Supporting Rationale, and confirm closing the goal.
Step Expected: The goal is closed and the selected reason and Supporting Rationale are saved.

Title: Check closed and voided goal status filters and See History

Step Action: From PGI & Notes, open View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs and set Status to Closed.
Step Expected: The list shows closed goals.

Step Action: Expand a closed goal using the + icon.
Step Expected: The expanded item shows the See History icon.

Step Action: Set Status to Voided (from Open).
Step Expected: The list shows goals voided from Open.

Step Action: Expand a voided goal using the + icon.
Step Expected: The expanded item shows the See History icon.

Title: Check goal card placement and appearance

Step Action: In View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs, set Status to Closed and click See History for a closed goal.
Step Expected: The Goal History modal opens with the goal card above the search bar and history table.

Step Action: Compare the goal card position and styling with the cards in the Intervention and Problem History modals.
Step Expected: The goal card uses the same position and style as the cards in the Intervention and Problem History modals.

Step Action: Close the modal and open See History for a goal under Voided (from Open).
Step Expected: The voided goal's card appears above the search bar and history table with consistent styling.

Title: Check collapsed goal card content and current status

Step Action: Open Goal History for a closed goal with known category, priority, title, individualized description, and Target Date.
Step Expected: The card is collapsed by default and shows the correct domain/category label, priority, title, individualized description, and Target Date: [date] | Closed. Expanded-only details are hidden.

Step Action: Open Goal History for a goal voided from Open with known details and Target Date.
Step Expected: The collapsed card shows that goal's details and Target Date: [date] | Voided.

Step Action: Compare each card's content with its goal card in the Open Goals list.
Step Expected: The card content matches the corresponding Open Goals card, with status reflecting the goal's current state.

Step Action: Inspect the card for the previous status and the close or void reason.
Step Expected: The card shows neither the previous status nor the close or void reason; those details are available only in the history table.

Title: Check goal card when Target Date is unavailable

Step Action: Open Goal History for a closed goal without a Target Date.
Step Expected: The card displays Target Date: Not available | Closed.

Step Action: Open Goal History for a goal voided from Open without a Target Date.
Step Expected: The card displays Target Date: Not available | Voided.

Title: Check long domain or category label truncation

Step Action: Open Goal History for a closed goal with a domain/category label long enough to be truncated.
Step Expected: The label is truncated with an ellipsis using the same behavior as on the Open Goals card.

Step Action: Compare the card's label with the same goal in the Open Goals list.
Step Expected: The label truncation is consistent and does not overlap or obscure other card content.

Title: Check goal card expand and collapse

Step Action: Open Goal History and click show more.
Step Expected: The card expands, Created by, Created Date/Time, and Patient Friendly Description appear, and the link changes to show less.

Step Action: Click show less.
Step Expected: The expanded details are hidden and the link changes back to show more.

Step Action: Expand and collapse the card while observing the search bar and history table.
Step Expected: The search bar and history table remain visible and usable and retain their state.

Title: Check correct goal card and collapsed state when reopening history

Step Action: Open a goal's history, expand its card, and close the modal.
Step Expected: The modal closes.

Step Action: Reopen the same goal's history.
Step Expected: The card is collapsed by default and displays the selected goal's details.

Step Action: Close the modal and open history for a different goal with different details.
Step Expected: The card and history show the newly selected goal with no stale content from the previous goal.

Step Action: Open history for a voided goal after viewing a closed goal.
Step Expected: The card is collapsed and shows the selected goal's details and current Voided status.

Title: Check closing and voiding changes appear in the history table

Step Action: Open history for a goal closed from In Progress with a known close reason and Supporting Rationale.
Step Expected: The table has Change Date, Changed By, Field, and Change columns and records the person and date/time of closing.

Step Action: Inspect the closing entries in the history table.
Step Expected: The table records Status (In Progress to Closed), Status Reason with the selected close reason, and Supporting Rationale with the saved rationale.

Step Action: Open history for a goal voided from Open with a known void reason and Supporting Rationale.
Step Expected: The table records the person and date/time of voiding, Status (In Progress to Voided), Status Reason with the void reason, and Supporting Rationale with the saved rationale.

Step Action: Inspect the closed and voided goal cards while comparing them with the history entries.
Step Expected: The cards show only the current Closed or Voided status; the previous status, reason, and rationale are in the history table.

Title: Check goal changes before closure or voiding and no later edits

Step Action: Use a goal with known changes made before closure or voiding, including a Status change and a Target Date change, then open its history.
Step Expected: Each pre-terminal change appears with its changed field and change, the person who made it, and the date and time.

Step Action: Inspect the history through the closing or voiding event.
Step Expected: The table includes the changes from creation through closure or voiding, including Status, Status Reason, and Supporting Rationale for the terminal event.

Step Action: Attempt to edit the closed or voided goal after opening its history.
Step Expected: The closed or voided goal cannot be edited.

Step Action: Refresh or reopen its history after the attempted edit.
Step Expected: No change is recorded after the goal's closing or voiding event.

Title: Check goal history search and column sorting

Step Action: Open Goal History for a goal with known history entries.
Step Expected: The table displays Change Date, Changed By, Field, and Change.

Step Action: Search for a value present in the history and then for a value with no matching entries. Clear the search.
Step Expected: Matching entries are shown for the matching search; existing no-results behavior is shown for the unmatched search; clearing search restores all entries.

Step Action: Sort each sortable column in both supported directions.
Step Expected: The table sorts as it does in the Intervention and Problem History modals without changing row data.

Step Action: Apply a search and sort, then expand and collapse the goal card.
Step Expected: The search text, matching results, and sort order are preserved; the search and table remain usable.

Title: Check long history scrolling and Close button

Step Action: Open Goal History for a goal with long content and enough history entries to require scrolling.
Step Expected: The card and history remain readable and the modal scrolls when needed.

Step Action: Scroll through the history table.
Step Expected: The Close button remains accessible.

Step Action: Click Close.
Step Expected: The modal closes and returns to the underlying PGI view.

Step Action: Reopen the modal, expand the card, and scroll through the long history.
Step Expected: The Close button remains accessible and closes the expanded modal.
